news.title: 2 years of DCAing and my holding still under the water, with no gain
news.summary:
They tell you to dollar cost average. They tell you it's a hedge against inflation and currency debasement.

But after over two full years of consistent buys, watching the price consolidate while everyday living expenses continue to climb, the reality looks very different.

Losing hope on this, it’s wasting my time

submitted by /u/Public-Lingonberry-2
